title_original: ‘All of a Sudden,’ ‘Clarissa,’ ‘La Gradiva,’ ‘The Invite’ and ‘Tender Loving Care’ Lead Gothams Nominees

blocks.text: “All of a Sudden,” “Clarissa,” “La Gradiva,” “The Invite” and “Tender Loving Care” lead the nominations for the 36th edition of The Gothams with four nods each.

The Gotham Film & Media Institute announced nominations for the 36th edition of The Gothams, singling out 42 feature films and 25 performances in 11 award categories. “Clarissa” and “The Invite” were also nominated for best feature, alongside “Club Kid,” “The Debut,” “Dreams in Nightmares,” “Josephine,” “Mouse,” “Paper Tiger,” “Primetime,” “Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma” and “Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother.”

blocks.text: “It’s a pleasure to announce this year’s nominees. It has been a remarkable year for film, with audiences turning out in theaters for bold, distinctive work from first-time filmmakers and established artists alike,” said Jeffrey Sharp, executive director of The Gotham Film & Media Institute, announcing the nods. “This year’s nominations, alongside our Tributes and the return of the Audience Award, reflect that abundance and celebrate the creative community that has been at the heart of The Gothams for more than three decades.”
